title: Trust Region Continual Learning as an Implicit Meta-Learner
abstract: arXiv:2602.02417v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Continual learning aims to acquire tasks sequentially without catastrophic forgetting, yet standard strategies face a core tradeoff: regularization-based methods (e.g., EWC) can overconstrain updates when task optima are weakly overlapping, while replay-based methods can retain performance but drift due to imperfect replay. We study a hybrid perspective: \emph{trust region continual learning} that combines generative replay with a Fisher-metric trust region constraint. We show that, under local approximations, the resulting update admits a Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) interpretation with a single implicit inner step: replay supplies an old-task gradient signal (query-like), while the Fisher-weighted penalty provides efficient offline curvature shaping (support-like). This yields an emergent meta-learning property in continual learning: the model becomes an initialization that rapidly \emph{re-converges} to prior task optima af

translated_title: 信任区域持续学习作为一种隐式元学习器
translated_abstract: 持续学习旨在顺序地学习多个任务而不发生灾难性遗忘，然而标准策略面临一个核心权衡：基于正则化的方法（如EWC）在任务最优解弱重叠时可能过度约束模型更新，而基于回放的方法虽能保持性能，却会因回放不完美而产生漂移。我们研究了一种混合视角：将生成式回放与Fisher度量信任区域约束相结合的信任区域持续学习。我们证明，在局部近似下，由此产生的更新可被解释为具有单个隐式内步的模型无关元学习（MAML）：回放提供旧任务的梯度信号（类似查询集的作用），而Fisher加权惩罚则提供高效的离线曲率塑造（类似支持集的作用）。这使得持续学习中涌现出一种元学习特性：模型成为一个初始化，能够快速地重新收敛到先前的任务最优解……
tldr: 该论文提出将生成式回放与Fisher度量信任区域约束相结合的信任区域持续学习方法，并证明其等价于具有单个隐式内步的MAML元学习，使模型成为能够快速重新收敛到旧任务最优解的初始化。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that trust region continual learning, which combines generative replay with a Fisher-metric trust region constraint, admits an implicit single-inner-step MAML interpretation, turning the model into an initialization that rapidly re-converges to prior task optima.
